CustomField.description: Used in flow Document_Checklist_Items_Review_Documents to sort critical statuses for review at the top of the datatable.
CustomField.formula: IF( LOWER( TEXT( Status ) ) = 'uploaded', 1, IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER( TEXT( Status ) ), 'not verified') , CONTAINS(LOWER( TEXT( Status ) ), 'not yet verified') ) , 2, null) )
CustomField.label: Status Sort Order
